objective.formula: J = cost_norm + lambda * nav_log_a; cost_norm = sum_e w_e |items(lca_e)| / (n W) (Dasgupta, items under their class); nav_log_a = mean over items of sum over the classes on the path of (a + log2 fan-out), fan-out = child classes, or works in a leaf class
objective.constraints: 2-12 child classes, at most 4 class levels, leaf classes of at least 5 works, every class a contiguous run of the fixed shelf order

run.placement_source: own insertion (nearest leaf centroid, leaf splits)
own: 80% fitted, 20% inserted, scored on the whole corpus graph
own insertion into the scheme fitted on the other 80% (held out)
own (the 80% the split scheme was fitted on: in-sample)
own placements of the full fit (in-sample) restricted to the 20%
